release_notes: Fixes GHL reporting 'API Key Invalid' with a stale saved key, fixes log-upload 401 errors by moving all uploads to one verified Gist token, and shows the rejected key's fingerprint on failed permission tests
changelog: FIXED: A stale API key saved next to the app could shadow the key saved in Settings, so GHL kept saying 'API Key Invalid' even after pasting a fresh key — Settings now wins and the stale copy is archived automatically
FIXED: 'Send Logs' failed with 'Upload Failed - 401 Bad credentials' — all log uploads now go through a single verified Gist token via the SideKick CLI
IMPROVED: When the GHL permission test rejects a key, the popup now shows the rejected key's fingerprint (pit-...XXXX) so a stale key is instantly recognisable
IMPROVED (internal): The build aborts automatically if the log-upload token has been revoked by GitHub

IMPROVED: A failed GHL permission test now logs the 401/403 error details and a redacted key fingerprint, and uploads them automatically when Auto-Send Logs is on — so connection issues can be diagnosed without asking for the key

NEW: GHL Test button now runs a full permission check — verifies all 13 API scopes SideKick uses and reports per-feature results (invoice sync, pipeline, contact sheet, room capture email, Cardly) instead of just 'key is live'
NEW: Clear fix instructions — a missing scope names the exact scope to enable in GHL → Settings → Private Integrations; invalid key and wrong-location are told apart explicitly
IMPROVED: Sync failures with 401/403 now self-diagnose — the error message says which scope is missing (or if the key/location is wrong) instead of a generic 'API authentication failed'
IMPROVED (internal): All GHL API calls route through a single shared client with unified retries, PII-redacted logging; duplicate logging/config code removed
FIXED: Doubled pit- token paste no longer breaks GHL auth
Previous (v3.0.34): Invoice sync no longer reports success when the GHL invoice fails to create
